comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts industrial gripper hardware; PR-1298 prunes a dead rose stem above a bud and bins the cutting.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires driver/wrench countertorque; PR-1298 requires target discrimination, secateur placement, cutting, simultaneous offcut retention, and disposal.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a locked target angle retained across cycles; PR-1298 requires a cut 3–15 mm beyond the bud, preserved plant, contained cutting, and safe tool release.
comparison.reason: No coupled adjustment or retained-motion verification is present in the pruning task.
